name.description: The name of the plugin: lowercase letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter.

opstruss.description: The oldest OpsTruss version that reads this file, as MAJOR.MINOR.

requires.description: Programs that must be in PATH for every task of the plugin.

env.description: Variables the plugin asks for, by name or by pattern as in pass:; the project grants them with pass:.

state.description: Where the state of a unit is: opstruss, the outputs of up in its record, or tool, the files of the tool in the tool directory of the unit; opstruss by default.

inputs.description: Inputs of the units that use the plugin, which their with: gives, read by every task.

outputs.description: Outputs that up writes, or tool when the code of the user in the tool names them.

tasks.description: The tasks of the plugin: the standard tasks plan, up, destroy, status, and logs, hooks such as exec, and tasks of its own.

bin.description: Binaries that OpsTruss downloads for the plugin, by name and platform, which its programs find in PATH.

url.description: The https URL of the binary, or of a .tar.gz archive that holds it at its root.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file at url.

backend.description: A backend that keeps the state of stacks; not supported yet.
